lines.en: I decide to spend yet another morning at the soccer field.
I feel like I’ve been doing that a lot lately.
Combine that with the fact that my trips here are normally pretty exhausting to begin with and it’s surprising that I’m still even showing up.
Who would have thought I’d get so hooked on hanging around a girls’ soccer team?
Sure, there are the skin tight shorts...the thigh-highs...the toned and developing muscles...
Actually, it does make sense that I keep coming here when I look at it that way.
Hey, Karin
: Hey, Karin. What are you three up to today?
: Ah-! W-W-What?! Who’s there?!
: Open your eyes and find out...
: Oh...Umm...Hey?...
: You kind of surprised me. I didn’t even hear you coming.
: Heya, Sensei. Why’d ya call out to Karin? You know she has a heart attack whenever a boy shows up.
: And, of course, I was right.
: Am I...a plaything to you?! You can’t just toy with my condition like that!
: There will be more times?!
: Of course. I’ll have you warm up to me if it’s the last thing I do.
: Um...well...
: I guess if you're okay with waiting...I-
: Aaaaaanyway...I’m gonna interrupt this special moment to bring you an important announcement.
: Wait, what?
Hey, Miku
: Hey, Miku. What are you guys up to?
: Oh, Sensei! We’re just hangin’ around on the giant blue step thingy, talkin’ about life and whatnot.
: Why is the soccer team having a discussion about life so early in the morning?
: Shouldn’t you three be practicing for whatever fake-game you have coming up next?
: Um...It sounds kinda rude when you call ‘em fake.
: Well, they are, aren’t they? They don’t count for anything.
: We tend to use the word unofficial, Sensei...
: Yeah, what Karin said. And besides, all games have a purpose! Even the fa- Erm, even the unofficial ones!
: If we don’t keep practicin’ we’ll be S-O-L when it comes time to actually play a real team.
: Just of out of curiosity, Miku, do you know what S-O-L stands for?
: Of course I do~ Hahaha...
: It stands for-
Hey, Kirin
: Hey, Kirin. What’s up?
: Huh? What?
: Oh...Uhh, hey.
: I saw you coming but I didn’t really think you were going to call out to me over those two.
: Yeah, what gives? Did you and Kirin become secret friends behind our backs or somethin’?
: No. But we do have a sort of contract together now.
: Yeaaahhhh...I forgot about that...hahaha...
: A contract? What kind of contract?
: Are you two working on some sort of...new training regimen or something?
: Well, that is one way to put it.
: Dude.
: Sorry. Couldn’t help it.
: I’m confused. What other sort of contract is there?
: Yeah, now I’m kinda curious too.
: Hey! Uhh, let’s just leave it alone for now, okay? Hahahah~
: You’re actin’ kinda weird today...
: Shut up. Besides, didn’t you have something you wanted to ask him?
: Something to ask- Oh!
: Sensei! I hereby proclaim you the new coach of the soccer team!
: Wait, what?
: What just happened?
: Can she do that?
: There is no limit to my power! Mwahahahaha!
: She technically can’t, but are you really gonna say no to that face, Sensei?
: What face? The one she has on now?
: Tremble before me, mortal!
: Kirin, are you sure this is the face you’re talking about?
: What’s wrong? I think she’s cute when she turns into a supervillain.
: Jokin’ aside, I’m puttin’ my foot down, Sensei. You’ve kept me waitin’ for far too long.
: We’ve all got achin’ muscles just beggin’ to be massaged by those magic hands of yours!
: Wait, what?!
: Yeah! Haven’t you heard? Sensei is apparently a super good moose!
: Masseuse, Miku. It’s masseuse.
: Also, I’m just okay. I never said I was a god.
: Wait, Miku! I know you said it would be good to have him around, but I’m pretty sure he’s not allowed to like, touch us...
: I don’t mind~ My legs have been suuuuuper sore lately. I’m sure some physical therapy will get all of those knots out in a jiff.
: Why wouldn’t Sensei be allowed to touch us? The last coach did it all the time and you always talked about how great ya felt after.
: The last coach was a girl, though...She didn’t have any...ulterior motives...
: I can hear you, you know...
: Hmm...
Miku pauses for a moment and stares deep into my soul.
She doesn’t believe the whole ‘ulterior motives’ thing, does she?
Wait a second. I do have ulterior motives. Why am I getting so up in arms about this accusation?
: *Ahem* Sensei. Or shall I say...Coach!
: Sensei is fine.
: Coach! Do you have any ulterior motives when it comes to the [young]women of the soccer team?
: Yeah, Sensei~ You weren’t planning on doing anything naughty to us, were you?
Kirin, I’m really going to need you to keep it together right now...
: Of course not. I won’t touch anyone how they don’t want to be touched.
: Hold on a second...I’m not entirely satisfied with that answer.
: What do you mean by how they want to be-
: Sounds good to me! You’re the moose here. You know what’ll work best.
: Miku! Don’t I get any sort of say in this? I’m second in command and a year older than you.
: You're also a year older than me and I’m still like three times more mature than you~
: You still sleep with a teddy bear, Kirin! I don’t want to hear it!
: And if you’re more mature than me, how come your curfew is an hour earlier than mine?
: Who cares about a stupid curfew? At least I don’t start crying any time a boy looks at me.
: So, Sensei-Coach-Master-
: Master has been added on now as well?
: As you can see, things can get a little dysfunctional around these here parts.
: So what that means is, as our new coach, you’re gonna have to keep these two in check so they stop frickin’ fightin’ all the time.
: Are they really always like this?
: Well...not all the time. But yeah, pretty often.
: I try to step in when I can but it’s not like a pipsqueak who’s just barely outgrown her trainin' bra can really do much to someone Karin’s size.
: And Kirin’s kinda scary in her own way too. Like one of those feisty types that’ll pull ‘yer hair if ya mess with her.
Yeah, I definitely get that vibe from Kirin as well.
: And you’re really sure about me being the coach? I think I’ve told you before, but I really can’t be here every day.
: That’s totally fine! We can always do stuff later on if ya can’t make it to the field.
: None of us really have anythin’ to do besides soccer and trainin’ and whatnot anyway.
: Oh, actually! I’ve got an even better idea!
: How about you take down our phone numbers?!
: I second that! Take mine first, Sensei!
Kirin pulls a smartphone out from the inside of her shirt and types out her contact info on it before holding it up for me to see.
I type the numbers down in my phone and click ‘save,’ still awaiting the next two numbers.
Congratulations! You now have Kirin’s cell phone number!
: I can’t remember...do ya already have my number, Sensei?
: Nope, don’t think so. Here, you can type it in yourself.
: Coolio!
Miku runs over and rapidly types her number into my phone.
Congratulations! You now have Miku’s cell phone number as well!
: Kirin and I are gonna go ahead!
: Good luck tryin’ to get Karin’s number, Sensei! She’s never given it to a boy before!
: Mmh...
: Umm...I-
: You don’t have to give me your number if you don’t want to, Karin.
: Huh?
: I don’t blame you for feeling weird around guys. Especially older ones like me.
: If anything, I think that most of the other girls are surprisingly forward.
: Um-
: Uhh-
: I know you’ve been on the team for a while and I obviously wouldn’t want to be stepping on your toes, but-
: T-T-T-Take my number too!
: Mmmnnn...
: Are you sure?
Karin quickly nods her head up and down in place of responding.
I hand her my cell and, with trembling fingers, she types her phone number in.
Sure, she needs to backspace some of the digits a few times, but she gets it done in the end.
Congratulations! You now have Karin’s cell phone number too!
Wow! Three phone numbers in one day! It’s almost like you’re the protagonist of a porn game!
: Okay bye!
Somehow, I don’t even think Miku would be able to keep up with her right now...
Karin’s affection has increased to [karin_love]!
Kirin’s affection has increased to [kirin_love]!
Miku’s affection has increased to [miku_love]!
